newsitem.title: LATVIA: INVESTMENT BANK LAT BOND COUPON ANNOUNCED.
newsitem.headline: INVESTMENT BANK LAT BOND COUPON ANNOUNCED.

text.p: Latvia's Investment Bank on Wednesday published data on its lat denominated one million lat bond issue, including the coupon, which is the average yield of Latvian government six-month T-bills plus 1.25 percent.
The prospectus of the issue, which is the first by a local issuer, was approved by the securities commision on May 12.
The issue contains 10,000 bonds with a nominal value of 100 lats and the initial placement begins on June 6 or the 15th day after the first publication of issue details.
The initial placement lasts 28 days and the bond matures on July 6, 1999.
The Investment Bank earlier said it issued the bond to finance investment projects and might consider similar bond issues in the future.
The Investment Bank is an institution of the Latvian government and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), which funnels loans to medium and small-sized businesses.
